notes.title: Plunder and Wonder — The Pirates World Sets Sail!
notes.content:
Ahoy, travelers! The Pirates World is no longer just a whisper on the waves — it's now a fully explorable, content-rich region with a complete story quest line, new islands, wild new units, and some deeply questionable seafood philosophy.

🗺️ New Locations Added:
[list]
[*]Crabylon – Where man and crab have united... somehow.
[*]The Isle of Wipe – A once-proud sponge civilization reduced to one grimy survivor.
[*]Sunken Cavern – An eerie underwater passage full of secrets.
[*] Ship Fortress – Board the most heavily defended (and over-compensated) vessel on the sea.
[/list]
*All of these locations are accessible from the private door inside the coffee shop — if you know, you know.


⚔️ New Units to Recruit or Face:
[list]
[*] Mast Sniper – Because height advantage is everything.
[*] Sponge – Surprisingly absorbent. Emotionally and otherwise.
[*] Sharkataur – Half-shark, half-beast, all bad attitude.
[*] Kraken – Tentacles. So many tentacles.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45473911/2bb4d342f545a1acb7522df6e5de3b80a407e56e.gif[/img]

 New Spell:

 Crablightenment – Achieve inner peace. And outer pincers.

📖 A Tale of Salt, Regret, and Rope-Bound Madness

The pirate lords Woodbeard and Kraktacle will stop at nothing to hold their grip on the sea — but they aren't your only concern.
Someone from your past awaits: Ivana, a ghost from your childhood, lost in a storm of memory and trauma.
This journey isn't just about treasure... it's about confronting what you've buried.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45473911/be20987b4531fd623b32279170a207116d95da95.gif[/img]

Notable Fixes:
[list]
[*] Default action key is now [E] for a more familiar control scheme.
[*] Interaction bubble now includes an indicator to make talking, looting, and activating things more intuitive.
[/list]

🛠️ Next Up: Goblins World

The next update will focus on finishing the Goblins World, accessible from the kitchen in the southernmost restaurant in Neural Haven. Expect strange mushrooms, a recluse witch, and goblins with questionable business ethics.
